items.headline: $KAT Plans Revenue-Funded Buybacks for Stakers
items.summary: Katana will retire emissions voting and start revenue-funded $KAT buybacks, with unstaking cooldowns shortened Nov. 17 and full onchain automation to follow.

items.headline: $ZEC Plan Would Pull 50,000 Tokens From Treasury
items.summary: A new Zcash draft would end ZCG's 8% funding stream and lock 50,000 $ZEC into a development and legal-defense reserve. Polling starts Nov. 16.

items.headline: $ENA: $100M BUIDL Liquidity Facility Goes Live
items.summary: Securitize and Ethena launched a facility letting BUIDL holders swap into stablecoins 24/7, starting with $25M each in USDC and BUIDL. Big DeFi-RWA crossover for $ENA.

items.headline: $PYTH Adds Real-Time NYSE Data Onchain
items.summary: Pyth Network now streams Level 1 data from five NYSE Group exchanges through its marketplace, pushing $PYTH deeper into institutional market data.

items.headline: $WELL Cuts Collateral Limits, Drops VELO & wrsETH
items.summary: Moonwell's MIP-X75 slashes backing for loans on Base and Optimism; overextended borrowers face liquidation unless they deleverage. Key risk event for $WELL holders.
